title: Firm / account choice for the crypto-firm books, nested (settings and firm chosen on 2022-24, evaluated on 2025-26)

v7 (Binance-perp firms): Crypto Fund Trader 2-Phase $100k + weekly payouts + 90% split

grid per firm: challenge {1.0, 1.5, 2.0} x funded {1.0, 1.5} x daily stop 0.5 of the firm's daily limit
selection: per firm: max 2022-24 bootstrap mean net with P(profit) >= 0.90; then the firm with the highest 2022-24 mean net (per account fee included)
evaluation: chosen firm + settings vs the current choice (HyroTrader 2-Step $100k / BrightFunded Classic, 2.0 / 1.5 / 0.5) on 2025-26 bootstrap and the halved-mean stress; adopt as the recommendation only if 2025-26 net is higher and P(profit) not lower by more than 0.02
caveat: preset terms partly ASSUMED (see propfirms.py notes); the user must verify on the firms' sites
